otherHeat: Its own heater and controller (set by hand)
notes: A DigiBoil (Fritz, 2026-11-07, Rule 5.39): it heats itself and Skynet does not switch any of it. Built in: its Power switch and Heater switch, its temperature set point and screen (a Manual vessel Widget, DigiBoil_Controls), and the small silver spigot with BSP threads on its outlet, a Manual valve (DigiBoil_Spigot). A Process sets them and a pop-up asks you to do it by hand; its screen goes back to °C every time it is turned off, so a set point in °F is given in °C too.
